title: The EIA publishes Btu conversion factors that estimate heat content
summary: The EIA publishes Btu conversion factors that estimate heat content.
body: The U.S. Energy Information Administration publishes British thermal unit conversion factors and says they estimate the heat content of a quantity of energy measured in physical units. The source says: "The thermal conversion factors in the following tables can be used to estimate the heat content in British thermal units (Btu) of a given amount of energy measured in physical units, such as barrels or cubic feet." A conversion factor translates units. It is not a price, and it is not a claim that two fuels are interchangeable in a particular machine.
